text: You draw near to the summit, for which your soul was revived.
zh: 汝已临近终局之巅——汝之魂灵正是为此而复苏。

text: Recall thy divine charge - thy burden - granted by me.
zh: 忆起我授予汝的神圣使命——汝之重担。

text: Bring me the Champion's Coin, that my will may echo across the realms once more.
zh: 将冠军硬币带来给我，让我的意志再度回荡于诸界。

text: I shall bring you the Champion's Coin!
zh: 我会将冠军硬币献给您！

text: I will claim the Champion's Coin as my own.
zh: 我要将冠军硬币据为己有。

text: Take into thee my blessing, and let what stands in your way crumble beneath thy will!
zh: 领受我的祝福吧，让一切阻挡汝之物，皆在汝的意志下崩解！

text:
In you, I placed the weight of destiny.
I was deceived.
zh:
我曾将命运之重托付于汝。
我竟受了蒙骗。

text:
You are not the vessel of my will.
You are not the Champion I summoned forth.
zh:
汝并非我意志的容器。
汝并非我召唤而来的冠军。

text: Now fall silent, for your life returns to the void from whence I drew it!
zh: 沉寂吧，汝之生命将归还于我曾汲取它的虚空！
